value.signature: fn check_reference_index (& self , rows : & Collected < '_ > , meter : & mut AuditMeter) -> Result < () , AuditFailure >

exception.justification: Justified: Memory audit adapter work inherits the enclosing metered audit operation.

review.body: { for row in & rows . results { meter . visit (result_location (row . scope , row . identity)) ? ; let node = self . results . get (& (row . scope , row . identity)) . ok_or_else (| | meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , result_location (row . scope , row . identity))) ? ; if node . reference_index . len () != node . references . len () { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , result_index_location (row . scope , row . identity , "memory.reference_index") ,)) ; } let mut seen = Vec :: new () ; let location = result_location (row . scope , row . identity) ; meter . reserve (& mut seen , node . references . len () , location) ? ; seen . resize (node . references . len () , false) ; let mut previous = None ; for (position , & slot) in node . reference_index . iter () . enumerate () { let site = result_slot_location (row . scope , row . identity , "memory.reference_index" , position) ; meter . visit (site) ? ; let Some (reference) = node . references . get (slot) else { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , site)) ; } ; if seen [slot] || previous . is_some_and (| prior | prior >= coordinate (reference . use_)) { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , site)) ; } seen [slot] = true ; previous = Some (coordinate (reference . use_)) ; } } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The memory audit adapter checks a retained index inside the same bounded, observed audit invocation.
